verdict.rationale: Greptile lets users configure review triggers, custom standards/rules (greptile.json, custom-standards docs), strictness/noise control, and automated actions like Fix with your Agent triggered on review events, which is a form of rule-based automation tied to PR events. However, this is scoped to code review workflows only (triggering on PR open/comment events) rather than a general-purpose event/rule engine for arbitrary automation actions. missing for 10: evidence of a broader/generic rules engine spanning multiple event types beyond PR review, user-defined conditional logic beyond review strictness/custom standards, and independent confirmation these triggers work reliably as described.
